notes.title: Patch 1.02 Notes
notes.content:
[p]Patch 1.02 is now live! It's mainly a bug-fixing patch and addresses the following issues:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Bug fixes with interact system[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes with navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Added tracker to display the total number of narrations and photos found in the level[/p][/*][*][p]Input hints were added to all levels that do not have an intro cinematic (Drydock)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed total number of narrations and photos showing incorrect number when inside Morro Castle Interior[/p][/*][*][p]Updates button on main menu now points to the correct page[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed position of pause menu details when UI scale is low[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weather widget not being scrollable on gamepad when UI scale is high[/p][/*][*][p]Controller interaction enhancements and bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos and grammatical errors in descriptions of found photos[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes with shading issues[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes with teleporting[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes with collisions[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re continuing to test and monitor feedback for this release. If you encounter any issues as a result of this update, please reach out and we will do our best to follow up as we are able to. Future updates will add new content to the experience which we cannot wait to share with you![/p][p]Happy exploring!

~The Turbine Room Studios Team

[i]Screenshot by Discord user Lodkins.[/i][/p]
